authorization: The user requested English/French failures fixed after proper Small/Balanced evaluations. The parent reviewed the preserved reminder failure and approved only finite organizational tasks, including balanced quotes around a supported task. Opaque arbitrary quoted clinical tasks are explicitly excluded.

scope.stage: The existing post-routing replyFallback stage after the full21-tool model choice, on reply or a source-invalid nonreply. No early routing or narrowing of model alternatives.
scope.outerRequest: One current affirmative Remind me to or Rappelle/Rappelez-moi de/d', or modal me rappeler de/d', with finite existing English/French courtesy/modal prefixes. Production createReminder source validation must also pass.
scope.wholeSourceBounds: At most1000 characters, one line, no control characters/model-control opener; anchored complete source consumption. Optional single terminal punctuation and balanced double/curly-double/guillemet/single/curly-single task quotes. No extra outer action or unconsumed tail.
scope.englishTasks: Book/schedule an appointment, blood work, a blood test or laboratory/lab test, optionally with a named doctor/dentist/clinic role; call the clinic; prepare/bring documents, papers or notes for an appointment, including appointment documents/notes phrasing. Only finite articles/possessives and these named organizational roles are accepted.
scope.frenchTasks: Prendre/fixer/planifier/réserver un rendez-vous, optionally chez/à a médecin/dentiste/clinique role; réserver/planifier/programmer a bilan sanguin, analyse de sang, prise de sang or test; appeler la clinique; préparer/apporter documents, notes or papiers pour un rendez-vous. Only finite articles/possessives and these task phrases are accepted.
scope.quotedTasks: Quotes preserve the supported organizational task text and punctuation but never widen the finite grammar. Arbitrary clinical/dose/stop instructions remain excluded even inside complete balanced quotes.
excluded: date/time or other modifiers outside the finite task grammar
scope.sourcePreservation: Case/diacritic folding is for matching only. Pass the entire original source unchanged into production createReminder validation and return its existing .reminder(original) action. Retain all original quotes, Unicode and wording.
scope.action: Return reminder_draft and the existing createReminder decision/action. Open the existing reminder review screen and date picker; infer no due date/time, execute no task and persist nothing. Manual review/date choice/save remain required.
scope.typedContradictions: A source-closed organizational reminder cannot authorize a model-selected captureSymptom or createAppointment write, even if the task mentions an appointment. Reject those contradictory proposals and let the same post-routing recovery open the reminder. Existing appointment-note exclusion remains unchanged.
scope.priority: Otherwise valid source-appropriate nonreply actions retain their existing priority. Correctly model-routed reminders outside this recovery's finite grammar keep existing validation and manual draft behavior.
scope.recursionBoundary: The helper revalidates only .createReminder, whose production branch returns .reminder(original) without calling replyFallback. No recursive .reply validation or inference loop is added.
scope.attribution: Preserve raw routing, failed action and any generated/suppressed advice beside the application draft/origin/reason. Recovery earns application disposition credit only, never raw intent, model prose or clinical-answer credit.
